title: Qoneqt Video Factory

style_guidelines.color_palette: Deep violet-to-magenta-to-cyan mesh gradient background (#667eea → #f093fb → #00d4ff) fading to near-black (#0b0416) at the edges, frosted white glass panels at 12-18% opacity with 1px white border, pure white titles, lavender (#c4b5fd) accents, electric yellow (#ffe500) for key numbers
style_guidelines.typography: Bold 700-weight sans-serif titles with subtle shadow, clean 400-weight body, dramatic size contrast, left-aligned body text
style_guidelines.imagery: Floating translucent 3D glass spheres and abstract shapes with light refraction, soft luminous orbs, depth through layered transparency, no text baked into imagery
style_guidelines.layout: Frosted glass cards with 24px rounded corners floating above the gradient, one focal point per slide, 40% negative space
style_guidelines.effects: Backdrop blur on glass panels, soft white border glow, colored soft shadows, light particles
style_guidelines.visual_language: Apple Vision Pro / visionOS aesthetic, premium depth through transparency, futuristic yet approachable

image_backend: pollinations (free, no key); reference chaining approximated with a fixed seed and identical style prefix, because Gemini image models returned 429 on the free tier

slides.title: Qoneqt Video Factory
slides.subtitle: Topic in. Global Feed short out.
slides.visual_description: Hero gradient at full vibrancy, a large luminous glass sphere right of centre refracting violet and cyan light, smaller floating glass shards and light particles, dark vignette on the left third to hold the title card.

slides.title: The Global Feed is hungry. Video is slow.
slides.visual_description: Same gradient, calmer and darker; a cluster of small frosted glass tiles drifting apart on the right like an empty feed, subtle grain, left side kept dark and open for text.

slides.title: A video factory, not a video button
slides.visual_description: Same gradient; three translucent glass panels stacked in perspective across the lower half suggesting an assembly line, soft cyan glow along their edges, light trails linking them.

slides.title: Input → Process → Output
slides.visual_description: Same gradient, darkest variant; abstract glass conduit or pipeline running left to right with glowing nodes, a lot of dark negative space above and below for the flow diagram.

slides.title: Five things that make it work
slides.visual_description: Same gradient; five small glass spheres of different sizes floating in a loose arc near the top-right, subtle refraction, dark lower two-thirds for a grid of cards.

slides.title: Impact and feasibility
slides.visual_description: Same gradient with a rising cyan glow from the bottom edge; a few rising glass bubbles, dark upper half reserved for stat cards.

slides.title: Built and running tonight
slides.subtitle: Qoneqt doesn't need one AI video. It needs a factory. We built the factory.
slides.visual_description: Finale: gradient at highest vibrancy, burst of soft light rays from the centre-right, many floating glass particles, celebratory but restrained, left half dark for the screenshot.
